about.title: VPyLab
about.vision: Create 3D scenes and sound with Python in your browser. Change code and observe the results to explore programming, mathematics, and science.
learningItems: Connect coordinates, variables, and loops to visible motion.
Change values and conditions, then compare predictions with results to find causes.
Adapt examples and express your own ideas through code.
Review work notes and teammates’ code to explain and improve solutions.

feat.pythonDesc: Write code and observe motion in 3D scenes without installing software.
feat.coursesDesc: Follow guided courses or open and modify examples to experiment.
feat.gradingDesc: Solve missions, review grading results, and revise your code.
feat.soundDesc: Create sound effects and melodies in code and connect them to motion.
feat.teamDesc: Invite teammates by GitHub username, work together, and keep a record with every save.
feat.galleryDesc: Share your work and use others’ code as a starting point for new creations.

viewport.fitOnceTip: Frame every object once. Double-clicking the 3D view does the same.
viewport.autoFitTip: When on, the camera keeps adjusting so every object stays in view while the code runs. When off, the camera stays in one place. It starts off.

viewport.webglUnavailableHelp: You can still edit code and read console output. Turn on hardware acceleration in your browser settings, or open VPyLab in a current version of Chrome or Edge, to see the 3D view.
